skill.name: catch-all-segmenter
skill.description: Verifies a contact list with verify_email and splits catch-all domains into their own segment, grouped by domain, so they can be warmed at lower volume instead of dropped. Keeps verified, unknown and invalid separate and never counts catch-all as valid. Use when someone asks to segment catch-alls, split risky emails, handle accept-all domains or prepare a list for a slower warm-up send.
skill.summary: Verify contact lists with Leadsets and group catch-all addresses by domain without marking them as verified.
skill.author: leadsets

security_audit.summary: The shell, environment access, and reconnaissance alerts match documentation rather than the reported behaviors. Verification sends contact addresses to Leadsets without a required approval step, and connected exports can include all original contact columns. No evidence found of prompt injection or covert transfers.

remediation.issue: Leadsets receives contact addresses before the workflow requires explicit approval.
remediation.suggestion: Before the first verification request, disclose the provider, fields, and address count. Require approval for the transfer and set a record limit for the run.

remediation.issue: Connected exports can include unnecessary source columns.
remediation.suggestion: Require approval of the destination account and workspace before writing. Export an approved column list and keep unknown and invalid addresses out of campaigns.

content.user_title: Segment Email Lists by Verification Status
content.value_statement: Catch-all results can be mistaken for verified mailboxes when all addresses stay in one list. Use Leadsets to verify addresses, separate four statuses, and group catch-all contacts by domain.
actual_capabilities: Trim and lowercase email addresses, remove blanks and duplicates, and report counts before and after cleanup.
Check Leadsets quotas before verification and size batches to the available allowance.
Split addresses into verified, catch-all, unknown, and invalid segments.
Group catch-all addresses by domain, count contacts per domain, and flag domains with both verified and catch-all results.
By default, recheck addresses without a status or with a status older than 30 days.
Export segments to CSV or Google Sheets, or hand them to a connected sequencer.
limitations: Verification requires a Leadsets account and an MCP connection or REST API key. Each address checked uses one enrichment record.
A catch-all result does not prove that an individual mailbox exists.
The skill does not find replacement addresses or new contacts.
The skill does not send email or configure campaign schedules, volumes, or warm-up rules.

use_cases.title: Clean a Contact CSV
use_cases.description: Remove duplicate addresses and review all four segments before deciding which contacts to keep.

use_cases.title: Review Catch-All Domains
use_cases.description: Compare catch-all counts by domain without mixing uncertain mailboxes into the verified segment.

use_cases.title: Refresh CRM Verification Statuses
use_cases.description: Reuse recent statuses, recheck older entries within the record allowance, and report addresses left unchecked.

prompt_templates.title: Beginner: Split a Pasted List
prompt_templates.scenario: Review a small list without writing to a connected destination.
prompt_templates.prompt: Clean and deduplicate this pasted email list. Ask before sending addresses to Leadsets, then report verified, catch-all, unknown, and invalid counts.

prompt_templates.title: Basic: Group Catch-All Contacts
prompt_templates.scenario: Compare domains in a contact CSV.
prompt_templates.prompt: Verify this CSV with Leadsets after I approve the transfer. Group catch-all rows by domain, sort the domain summary by contact count, and flag domains with mixed results.

prompt_templates.title: Intermediate: Refresh a CRM List
prompt_templates.scenario: Limit repeated verification and review the results in Google Sheets.
prompt_templates.prompt: Keep statuses checked within 30 days. Show the estimated Leadsets record use and wait for approval before rechecking the rest. Ask before exporting to my Google Sheet.

prompt_templates.title: Advanced: Prepare a Limited Export
prompt_templates.scenario: Separate eligible contacts before a sequencer handoff.
prompt_templates.prompt: Show the estimated Leadsets record use and wait for approval before verifying. Verify at most 500 addresses. Show the sequencer workspace and export columns for approval before exporting only verified and catch-all contacts as separate segments.

output_examples.output: After cleanup, 100 unique addresses were checked. Results: 68 verified, 20 catch-all across six domains, eight unknown, and four invalid. The run used 100 records.

output_examples.input: Create an approved Google Sheet export and show which domains need review.
output: The sheet contains four status tabs and a catch-all domain summary.
Example.org has both verified and catch-all results. Its catch-all contacts remain separate from verified contacts.

best_practices: Confirm that you can share the contact addresses with Leadsets before starting verification.
Set a record limit and reuse recent statuses when they meet your needs.
Confirm the destination workspace and export only the fields needed for that destination.
anti_patterns: Treating catch-all or unknown addresses as verified mailboxes.
Rechecking every address without reviewing existing statuses or available records.
Copying every source column to a connected sequencer without reviewing the fields.

faq.question: What does catch-all mean?
faq.answer: The domain may accept mail for addresses even when their individual mailboxes cannot be confirmed. Catch-all stays separate from verified.

faq.question: What inputs can I use?
faq.answer: Use a CSV, a Google Sheet, a CRM view, or a pasted list. Each contact needs an email address.

faq.question: Does verification share contact data?
faq.answer: Yes. The skill sends addresses it checks to Leadsets. Review which contacts you can share before running verification.

faq.question: How many records does verification use?
faq.answer: Each address checked uses one enrichment record. The Leadsets usage check is free and runs before verification.

faq.question: Can I keep existing verification results?
faq.answer: Yes. By default, the skill rechecks only addresses with no status or a status older than 30 days.

faq.question: Does the skill send email?
faq.answer: No. It prepares segments and can export to a connected sequencer. You manage sending and schedules separately.
